_about: Bricked Sorting V14 shared interface. All four module chats build to these numbers. Do not edit; request changes in your module README under INTERFACE REQUESTS.
version: v14-interface-4.2 (2026-11-05 21:20): print-friendly rules; wall skin 2.4 (zone still 20); back access panel z 420..668
axes: right-handed: origin = floor center; +Y toward the front (the drawer pulls out +Y), +Z up, so +X is on the LEFT of a person facing the front drawer (wording fix 19:50; numbers unchanged). Bin numbers follow the real viewer at each drawer.

roof.stud_L_(-260): open ring OD 312 ID 290, z 720..780, the hopper sits inside

zones.F_frame: walls, floor, deck panel, roof, studs, corner columns, bracing. Bracing must stay out of the D, S and K zones.

D_drawer.rails: D also owns the under-drawer rails inside the spine tunnels (y -66..66 at x +-200 / +-300, z 8..34)

S_scoop.note: minus the corner columns; never below z 186 at any pose

plus: hopper inside stud L up to z 780 through the roof opening
drop funnel: cylinder r 30 at (330,0), z 335..390, through the deck hole (exit 335)

bins.height_note: drawer floor sits on the under-drawer rails (rail top ~z 34), so bins are about 139 tall to keep their tops at or below 176

drawer.runners: rails on the drawer UNDERSIDE that run back past the drawer through tunnels in the center spine; 625ZZ rollers fixed to the floor (load pair + anti-lift pair per rail, lateral guide rollers on one rail only, the other floats ~0.5); 16.4-16.6 running gap for the 16 mm bearings, one slotted roller for preload; hard stops; closed detent
drawer.note: each bank (~5 kg loaded) fully clears its face at 220
drawer.keying: front and back drawers mechanically keyed so neither fits the other side; a retaining bar holds all 8 bins so drawer seated = all bins present
drawer.why: a single-stage drawer cannot extend past its own depth unless its rails reach back beyond it; 205 travel puts the bins' back edge (y 75 closed) at y 280, 20 past the face, so bins lift straight out

scoop.dump_poses: carriage at each bins.x_centers[i], tilt toward -Y or +Y; the brick leaves the lip at |y| >= 100 (5 mm margin over the bin inner edge at 75 + brick) and z >= 190, on a surface tilted at least 40 deg so it slides; servo horn is not the bearing (pivot on its own shaft or bushings)
scoop.park_pose: level, carriage at x 330, everything above z 186 (drawer may open)
scoop.keepout_under_funnel: at every pose, nothing from S inside r 40 of (330,0) above z 330
scoop.suggested_geometry: shallow two-ended cup ABOVE the pivot: pivot z ~268 on its own shaft/bearings, lip 114 out and 25 above the pivot, dump at 40 deg -> lip at y 103, z 214; the opposite lip rises to ~360, so taper the open ends and the end walls to stay under 366; TPU pad on the floor so a dropped brick does not bounce out

bought_parts_allowed: electronics, motors, servos, switches, LEDs, 625ZZ bearings, GT2 6 mm belt + 20T pulleys + idler (scoop slide only), M3/M5 screws and nuts, M3 heat-set inserts, TPU/PTFE film. Everything else printed (no 2020 extrusion, no metal slides).

center_spine.note: free strip under the beam between the two drawers: F may put a structural spine here and D may bolt runners to its sides
center_spine.tunnels: leave tunnels 24 wide x 26 tall (z 8..34) along y at x = +-200 and +-300 for the drawer rails

service_clearance: 300 mm behind the machine for the back drawer
drum: keep the V13 drum as-is: 47b barrel 160 x 180 with helical flight, 49b static outlet plate (cradles new)

bin_ids.front: F1..F8, left to right as you face the front
bin_ids.back: B1..B8, left to right as you face the back
bin_ids.note: so B1 sits behind F8; numbering always reads left to right for the person at that drawer

side_marking: drawer faces in two filament colors (front and back), embossed F / B and 1-8 above each bin position, and a slide-in label card slot on each bin face for its category

beam.section: closed box, about 65 tall x 40 deep, 3-4 mm skins, ribs every 60-100 mm, PLA
beam.segments: 5 segments of ~200 (no joint at midspan), each seam a 60-80 mm internal sleeve plus screws; gusseted side-wall mounts
beam.belt: run the GT2 belt close to the beam's mid-height so tension does not twist it
beam.targets: < 2 mm sag at center with carriage and belt tension; scoop stays level across travel

switches: two KW11-3Z drawer-closed switches (front, back); no per-bin switches
cable: carriage cable in a small printed drag chain on the beam's back face (y -20..-35, z 195..255), exiting to the left deck cable slot

print_rules.estimates: grams as the slicer would print them: 3 walls (1.2 mm), 4 top/bottom layers, 15 % gyroid infill, not solid volume
print_rules.budget: whole machine <= ~15 kg filament and <= ~400 print hours; frame <= ~9 kg
print_rules.supports: none: overhangs <= 45 deg, bridges <= 30 mm, holes horizontal are teardrop or 0.2 mm sacrificial layer
print_rules.orientation: every part has a flat face to put on the bed; say the orientation in parts.json
print_rules.fits: 0.2 mm per side for slip fits, 0.1 for press fits, bearings 16.2 pockets; chamfer 0.6 on bed edges
print_rules.parts: fewer, bed-sized parts beat many small ones; panels near 240 x 240
print_rules.inserts: every insert hole reachable with a soldering iron after printing
